newsitem.title: USA: Designs Inc sees FY97 shr loss between $1.00/$1.15.
newsitem.headline: Designs Inc sees FY97 shr loss between $1.00/$1.15.

text.p: Designs Inc, a specialty retail apparel stores operator, said Monday it currently expects to incur a loss for fiscal year 1997 of from $1.00 to $1.15 a share.
The company said it estimates its total sales for fiscal 1997 to be in the range of $285 million to $295 million.

The company issued the estimates as it reported a net loss of $16.6 million or $1.06 per share for the second fiscal quarter of 1997 ended August 2. The latest quarter results compare with a net income of $554,000 or $0.04 per share in the same period last year.
Sales for the 1997 quarter were $64.5 million against $66.5 million for the simiilar quarter in 1996, it said.
For the six-month, year-to-date period, it said it had a net loss of $19.8 million or $1.27 a share, compared with a net loss of $591,000 or $0.04 per share for the same period in 1996, it said.
Sales for the six months of 1997, were $120.0 million compared with $125.9 million in the comparable period in 1996, it said.
For the second fiscal quarter of 1997, it said it recorded a pre-tax charge of $20 million or $0.75 per share after tax related to a strategy refocusing plan it recently adopted.

The plan involves liquidation of its Boston Traders brand product, closure of its New York product development office and planned closing of 17 Designs stores and 16 Boston Traders Outlet stores, it said.

The company said that the strategy shift is estimated to produce earnings and cash flow benefits of $6.8 million and $7.7 million, respectively, for fiscal 1998 and $10.6 million and $8.7 million, respecitvely, for fiscal 1999.
